actions.label: Wi-Fi
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && bluetoothctl power on || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(bluetoothctl show | grep -c "Powered: yes") -gt 0 ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Performance
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && powerprofilesctl set performance || powerprofilesctl set balanced'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(powerprofilesctl get) == "performance" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Balanced
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(powerprofilesctl get) == "balanced" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Power Saver
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && powerprofilesctl set power-saver || powerprofilesctl set balanced'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(powerprofilesctl get) == "power-saver" ]] && echo true || echo false'
